newsitem.title: USA: Garden Ridge sees Q3 net, revs down.
newsitem.headline: Garden Ridge sees Q3 net, revs down.

text.p: Garden Ridge Corp said late on Monday, after the market closed, that it expects to be profitable for the third quarter ending October 27, 1996, but may not earn as much as last year's third quarter.
The company said that fourth quarter earnings could also come in below analyst expectations.
Garden Ridge expects to report sales of about $56.0 million for the third quarter of fiscal 1997, compared with sales of $38.0 the previous third quarter.
The company said it expects same store sales to be about three percent below last year's levels.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for the company's third quarter is $0.06 a share, compared with $0.04 a share the year before.
